import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Prefix {
    static final int SIZE = 1000010;
    static final long MAXN = 1000000007L;
    static long ways;
    static int P, K;
    static int[] Parent = new int[SIZE], Rank = new int[SIZE];
    static Set<Integer> groups = new HashSet<>();
    
    public static int find_parent(int nd) {
        if (Parent[nd] != nd)
            Parent[nd] = find_parent(Parent[nd]);
        return Parent[nd];
    }
    
    public static void Union(int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]) {
            Parent[nd2] = nd1;
            Rank[nd1]++;
        } else {
            Parent[nd1] = nd2;
            Rank[nd2]++;
        }
    }
    
    public static long fast_exp_pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        P = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            Parent[i] = i;
            Rank[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            long val = ((long)K * i) % P;
            int Pa = find_parent(i);
            int Pb = find_parent((int)val);
            if (Pa != Pb)
                Union(Pa, Pb);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            groups.add(find_parent(i));
        }

        if (K == 0)
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P - 1, MAXN);
        else if (K == 1)
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P, MAXN);
        else
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, groups.size(), MAXN);

        System.out.println(ways);
        sc.close();
    }
}
